messages:
Gabe: Ran the stakeholder sync with two large regulated prospects. They both pushed hard on three things: emergency tenant hold, verifiable export integrity, and explicit commercial options for BYOK signing. Need a packaging decision by Thurs so sales can respond.

Noelle: High level recommendation from product: split into Core (holds + retention mapping + hold metadata in exports) and two paid extras: Evidence Integrity (Redwood-signed proofs + verification manifest) and BYOK-signing (customer-key signing + escrow/attestation). This gives fast-close path and monetization lanes.

Hanna: Compliance asks to make acceptance criteria explicit before we promise:
- holds are auditable (created_by, created_at, audit_id) and RBAC-protected
- holds survive restores and backfills (test required)
- exports include proof + instructions to verify (if proof enabled)
- proof verification reproducible with published steps for auditors
Add these to the spike.

Raj: Engineering notes: minimal MVP for Core = control-plane hold API + ledger + lifecycle skip for held prefixes. For Evidence Integrity we add Merkle-root generation + Redwood signing; BYOK-signing needs escrow, key attestation, additional legal. Rough effort: Core spike 1wk + 2 sprints; Evidence Integrity 2-3 sprints; BYOK 10+ sprints.

Gabe: Sales pressure: one customer will sign if we commit to Core + Evidence Integrity in 6 weeks and give a BYOK roadmap. They may provide a deposit to accelerate BYOK.

Noelle: Finance input: bundling everything ups ACV but reduces upgrade runway. Modular add-ons give clear ARR expansion. We should give sales both a fast close bundle (Core+Integrity) and a modular option.

Hanna: SOC2 mapping note: map hold toggle to CC6.x style control entries and produce test cases auditors can run. Also require immutable ledger retention policy for those audit logs.

Raj: Dev spike checklist (short):
- API: POST /v1/tenants/{tid}/holds -> returns hold_id + audit_id
- fields: created_by, created_at, reason, expires_at, audit_id
- lifecycle job: skip deletion for held prefixes (unit + integration test)
- export pipeline: include hold metadata in manifest; if proof enabled, attach proof_blob_url and signer metadata
- e2e test: create hold -> trigger lifecycle -> verify objects retained
I'll open S-22011 with these items.

audit-bot: Ticket S-22011 created: "spike: tenant-holds + export-proof-mapping" assigned to Raj. Reminder: add SOC2 test mapping.

Gabe: Quick API sketch for spec doc (minimal):

```
POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/holds
Body: { "active": true, "reason": "investigation-2026-04", "created_by": "legal@client.com", "expires_at": null }
Response: 201 { "hold_id": "H-20260410", "audit_id": "A-77c9" }
```

And export invocation:
```
POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/exports?proof=true&signer=redwood
Body: { "from": "2026-01-01", "to": "2026-04-01" }
Response: 202 { "export_id": "E-123", "proof_blob": "s3://.../proof-E-123.json" }
```

Noelle: Timelines: if spike green, push Core into next sprint (4-6 weeks to full delivery including tests). Evidence Integrity can be scoped to the following sprint. BYOK remains Q+ with paid acceleration option.

sales-bot: Suggestion: offer a refundable "BYOK acceleration deposit" that buys a 6-8 week fast-track for customers who need signing earlier. Legal must approve terms.

Hanna: Compliance: I'll draft the acceptance matrix and SOC2 test steps by Wed and attach to S-22011.

Raj: Starting spike Monday. Will post interim notes mid-week. If lifecycle skip proves low-risk, we can commit Core timeline to sales.

Gabe: Decision for now: present modular packaging to customers with a fast-close bundle option (Core + Evidence Integrity) and BYOK as paid premium. Solicit LOI/deposit for BYOK priority. Product to publish acceptance criteria and spike ticket by Wed.

Noelle: I'll prepare the customer-facing packaging one-pager for sales to send with the LOI template.

Gabe: Thanks team. 3pm PT sync to review spike scope and pricing. :thumbsup:
